items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Toots Camarato was in the band.

ctx.x: Was a pianist, yes. And very good arranger. And he was back in one of those Roy Nance groups, see and this boy had nothing but talent. And so we did and when Hamp came in town we were recording this music. we made Til Tom's Special and Toots Camarato was in the band. He wrote Shades of Jade, and we recorded a lot of stuff there.
